description: FreshStack-style held-out probes against astral-sh/uv (post-cutoff repo, last commit 2026-05-06; model cutoff was 2026-01). Hand-crafted from the source on 2026-05-07 without inspecting sweet-search behaviour. NEVER iterate against this set — only check at release milestones.

probes.query: how does uv resolve dependency conflicts when two packages need different versions of the same library
probes.notes: Pure NL question. Resolver uses PubGrub; conflict reports are formatted in pubgrub/report.rs; NoSolutionError lives in error.rs. Any of the three is acceptable as gold.

probes.query: where is the lockfile written to disk after a successful resolution
probes.notes: LockTarget::commit at lock_target.rs:342 is the only place that fs_err::tokio::write the encoded lockfile.

probes.query: how does uv decide whether to download a managed Python build or use one already on the system
probes.notes: PythonPreference + PythonDownloads enums steer this decision; discovery.rs is the primary file but downloads.rs is also acceptable.

probes.query: when uv installs a wheel where does it actually copy the files from cache into the virtualenv
probes.notes: linker.rs:255 link_wheel_files copies/links files into the venv; install.rs:29 install_wheel is the orchestrator.

probes.query: how does uv know whether the uv.lock file is stale and needs re-resolving
probes.notes: Lock::satisfies (lock/mod.rs:1614) is the workhorse; do_lock in commands/project/lock.rs:469 is the dispatcher.

probes.query: how does uv build a source distribution into a wheel before installing it
probes.notes: SourceBuild::build in build-frontend/lib.rs:844 invokes PEP 517 backend; source/mod.rs orchestrates fetch+build+cache.

probes.query: what controls whether uv compiles bytecode for installed packages and how is it triggered
probes.notes: compile.rs hosts the compileall worker and the COMPILEALL_SCRIPT shipped at install-time.

probes.query: how does uv pick between installing the latest version of a package and a pinned version from preferences
probes.notes: candidate_selector.rs:78 select() picks the candidate; preferences.rs holds the prior pin data.

probes.query: show me the Cache struct definition
probes.notes: Definition at uv-cache/src/lib.rs:164; user wants the full struct body, not a preview.

probes.query: show me the Planner struct that builds installation plans
probes.notes: Definition at uv-installer/src/plan.rs:31.

probes.query: show me the full Lock struct definition with all its fields
probes.notes: Definition at uv-resolver/src/lock/mod.rs:254; user wants every field shown.

probes.query: show me the Resolver struct definition
probes.notes: Definition at resolver/mod.rs:100; generic over Provider and InstalledPackages.

probes.query: show me the Workspace struct definition
probes.notes: Definition at uv-workspace/src/workspace.rs:143.

probes.query: show me the Interpreter struct definition with all fields
probes.notes: Definition at uv-python/src/interpreter.rs:45.

probes.query: show me the BuildDispatch struct definition
probes.notes: Definition at uv-dispatch/src/lib.rs:86; this is the BuildContext implementation that wires resolver/installer/builder.

probes.query: show me the Commands enum that lists every uv subcommand
probes.notes: Definition at uv-cli/src/lib.rs:415; user wants every variant in the enum.

probes.query: trace how uv add inserts a new dependency into pyproject.toml
probes.notes: commands/project/add.rs:63 is the entrypoint; PyProjectTomlMut::add_dependency in pyproject_mut.rs:337 does the actual TOML edit.

probes.query: what happens end-to-end when I run uv sync on an existing project
probes.notes: sync.rs:60 sync() entrypoint; sync.rs:633 do_sync orchestrates; lock.rs is invoked when lockfile is stale.

probes.query: how does uv tool install create an isolated environment and link entrypoints onto PATH
probes.notes: tool/install.rs:55 is the command; uv-tool/src/lib.rs hosts InstalledTools + tool_executable_dir for the bin shim location.

probes.query: trace how uv lock decides which package versions to write into uv.lock
probes.notes: commands/project/lock.rs:85 is the CLI entry; resolver/mod.rs:277 Resolver::resolve runs the actual PubGrub solve.

probes.query: where is the code that fetches a wheel from a registry index and caches it
probes.notes: RegistryClient handles HTTP; DistributionDatabase wraps it with caching + extraction.

probes.query: trace how uv venv creates a new virtual environment from scratch
probes.notes: commands/venv.rs:64 venv() is the CLI entry; uv-virtualenv/src/lib.rs:56 create_venv is the public entrypoint that delegates into virtualenv.rs for the file-system work.

probes.query: how does uv publish authenticate with PyPI using trusted publishing tokens
probes.notes: uv-publish/src/lib.rs:409 check_trusted_publishing is the entrypoint; trusted_publishing.rs hosts the OIDC services; commands/publish.rs is the CLI wrapper.

probes.query: how does uv clone a git dependency and pin it to a specific commit
probes.notes: GitSource::fetch (source.rs:65) drives the clone; git.rs:570 fetch() does CLI/libgit2 work; GitResolver caches resolved oids.

probes.query: what does the NoSolutionError type represent in the resolver and how is it formatted for users
probes.notes: Definition at uv-resolver/src/error.rs:162; Display impl at line 445.

probes.query: where is the ResolveError::ConflictingUrls variant constructed
probes.notes: ConflictingUrls is a variant of ResolveError defined at error.rs:67. Real codebase has no ConflictInGroup variant; ConflictingUrls is the closest analog.

probes.query: what does PubGrubReportFormatter do when rendering a resolution failure
probes.notes: Defined at pubgrub/report.rs:37; implements ReportFormatter from pubgrub crate at line 54.

probes.query: what error is raised when a wheel is missing a header file required to build a C extension
probes.notes: MissingHeaderError defined at build-frontend/src/error.rs:337; the Cause enum at line 131 enumerates which header was missing.

probes.query: where is the PublishError type that wraps trusted-publishing and upload failures
probes.notes: Definition at uv-publish/src/lib.rs:49.

probes.query: what does the SitePackagesDiagnostic enum represent and what variants does it have
probes.notes: Definition at uv-installer/src/site_packages.rs:622; reports issues found when scanning an existing site-packages directory (MetadataUnavailable, IncompatiblePlatform, etc.).
